title: Why Games Do Not Keep Every Texture in VRAM
description:
A modern game can contain more texture data than graphics memory can hold. This short animation explains mip levels, camera-driven residency and why a detailed surface may arrive late or disappear when the VRAM budget gets tight.

Sources:
https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/unreal-engine/texture-streaming-overview-for-unreal-engine
https://microsoft.github.io/DirectX-Specs/d3d/SamplerFeedback.html

Visuals: original Pulse Gaming diagrams.
Narration: generated locally with Kokoro TTS.
Music: an original ElevenLabs sound-effects bed licensed for finished editorial video.
Synthetic media disclosure: Yes.
